locations.note: In November 1991, two years after Ghostbusters II, a rookie joins the original team to chase ghosts across Manhattan.
The ghost is Dr. Eleanor Twitty, murdered by Edmund Hoover over the Gozerian Codex; capturing her opens a portal to the Ghost World, where the team fights Hoover as Azetlor the Destroyer.
The game opens at the Gozer exhibit, and a full level cleanses the museum.
A mausoleum rises in Central Park as a gateway between dimensions; the team rescues Ilyssa and Peck, finds Mayor Mulligan possessed by Shandor and defeats Shandor's Architect form.

routes.name: The Ghostbusters
routes.note: From Times Square through the Library and the Museum to the Central Park finale.
